name.baseName: Insulated Glass Unit, double glazing, laminated-laminated

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed within the ARCADIA Project (production chain study regarding glass products for windows “PRODUZIONE DI LASTRE E SISTEMI IN VETRO PER INFISSI E SERRAMENTI”). The dataset refers to the production of insulated glass unit double glazing composed of laminated-laminated, representative of the Italian average processing technologies commonly used for glass production. The data set covers relevant process steps / technologies over the supply chain of the represented cradle to gate inventory with a good overall data quality. The inventory is based on primary data for the Float glass production, and on secondary data (literature and/or LCI datasets) representative of Italian supply chain. Double glazing insulated glass unit is used as components (joined with various material profiles) for the production of windows to be applied into building sector. Dimensions and mass: surface 1 m2, thickness 28 mm (33.1-16-33.1), weight 31,7 kg/m2.

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription: Dalla Valle A., Lavagna M., Campioli A., 2023. “PRODUZIONE DI LASTRE E SISTEMI IN VETRO PER INFISSI E SERRAMENTI”. Internal report ARCADIA Project. Primary data of the main production processes (foreground data) collected from representative producers. Background dataset from Ecoinvent database cut-off (v. 3.6) were used for the LCA study.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Italy. Primary data collected from leading glass producers active on national context. Dataset representative of Italian production of insulated glass unit double glazing composed of laminated-laminated.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: Double glazing insulated glass unit consists of two sheets of glass sealed at the edges with a perimeter spacer that creates an intermediate cavity forming a single unit. The reference unit is 33.1-16-33.1, made externally and internally of laminated safety glass (3+3 mm). It obtains insulation properties mainly from the cavity introduced between the panes of glass (16 mm), that is filled by argon gas. The production process takes place after the manufacturing of laminated glass (see “Laminated Safety Glass, at production” dataset). Once collected the different glass panes, the sheets are first washed and dried to remove all dirty particles. They are then separated by an aluminium spacerbar and sealed around the perimeter using organic seals. The spacer bar is filled with desiccant to dry the air in the cavity and a secondary seal is then applied to hermetically seal the double glazing. The insulated glass unit is finally packed and stored in the warehouse, ready to be installed into window assembly. The system boundary considers A1 “procurement of raw materials”, A2 “transport”, A3 “production”, according to EN15804:2012+A1:2013 standard. The Cradle-to-gate analysis includes the input of materials, energy, water and the outputs of waste, emissions and transport related to the considered system boundary. Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system. Primary data (from leading glass producers) and secondary data (from established database) representative of Italian supply chain for the geographical characteristics and technologies used were collected. Inventory data have been collected as physical quantities of resources (materials and energy) used in the different processes. The benefits from the production and use of energy from incineration and landfill were excluded, as well as those deriving from the use of secondary materials produced from recycling of waste materials. Background data were modelled according to Ecoinvent v.3.6.
technology.technologicalApplicability: Double glazing insulated glass unit composed of laminated-laminated can be used as components (joined with various material profiles) for the production of windows to be applied into building sector.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system.
dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.deviationsFromCutOffAndCompletenessPrinc: None for the inventory. Completeness related to elementary flows cannot be evaluated.

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Metodology “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” and ISO 14040-44. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. Each dataset has been evaluated on the basis of the following 4 criteria: 1. Technological Representative; 2. Time Representative; 3. Geographic Representative; 4. Reliability. In this context the Reliability is very good. The data used are consistent, appropriate and reasonable in view of the goal and scope of the study. The system boundaries include all relevant processes and activity types from cradle to gate. A cut-off has been applied to production of equipment and infrastructure and to the processes involved in the recycling of glass. These are in line with the requirements of the “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” (Buttol et al., v2, November 2021). The LCI modelling choices follow the requirements of Buttol et al. (2021), such as allocation, consistency of included processes, and LCI methodology in general. It has been consistently applied along the whole dataset. The representativeness of the dataset (time-related, geographical, technology) is well documented and very good, thanks also to the involvement of relevant market operators. The precision and completeness of the dataset cannot be evaluated.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology.
